slides.transcript: Rosa: I used to do the books on Sunday nights with a glass of wine and a lot of swearing. Now Ledgerly does most of it before I open on Monday.

slides.pullQuote: Job costing used to be a spreadsheet only I understood.

items.name: Maya Reyes
items.text: Took the Cable Fold on a 6-day Wind River trip. Grilled trout every night, folded it flat every morning. Best thing in my pack and I've been guiding for 12 years.

items.title: Heirloom quality
items.text: Heavier than titanium, obviously, but nothing else sears like this over a fire. Seasoning held up to a week of eggs and bacon.

image.alt: A Dutch oven of chilli on a granite slab at sunset
image.name: ugc-trail-kitchen.jpg

items.caption: Chilli at 11,000 ft. The Ember came along for all 4 days.

items.title: Great pan, read the care card
items.text: Rusted a little after I left it wet overnight — my fault. Re-oiled it and it's been perfect since. Customer service sent a care kit for free.

items.name: Theo Lindqvist
items.text: PCT update: still carrying the Trail Kettle at mile 1,900. Every other piece of gear has been replaced at least once.
Toured the foundry in Bend — they let my kids pour sand into the moulds. Bought two skillets on the way out.
